BiblicalUsage: Mesha is a place in Arabia, named once as a boundary of the sons of Joktan. Genesis 10:30 says their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar, a mount of the east.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the table of nations keeps even the boundary towns, because every family had its dwelling from God.
